decisions.reason: As a core door-handle family that survived the firm's first post-launch review when other 2018 variants were removed, it likely meets aspiration levels well enough to retain with low risk of withdrawal.
This door-handle design also survived the early selection stage and fits the firm's established competencies, though design-specific demand is somewhat more uncertain than a broader product family.

The electronic access system is more uncertain because it is a newer, more capability-demanding adjacency, but a large firm with organisational slack will likely keep it for another year unless results clearly fall short of aspiration levels.
